reason_2_the_level_cannot_be_reproduced_.hardest_single_fact: the required multiple is not even monotone in the excess return. QCLN carries the largest excess return in the set at 21.24pp and needs a multiple of only 3.273, while RYT at 12.64pp excess needs 10.559. No residual-income family in which value rises with excess return at a common book basis can produce that ordering.
reason_2_the_level_cannot_be_reproduced_.conditionality: CONDITIONAL on the P/B-to-B0 adapter. The '18E P/B is printed by the report, but the mapping B0 = price / printed P/B is a FENO adapter, not a demonstrated statement of the book basis those tables used. Raised independently by cx (Codex) and accepted. The 62.2% best-case level error and the QCLN/RYT non-monotonicity therefore refute the family GIVEN that adapter; they do not refute it unconditionally.
reason_2_the_level_cannot_be_reproduced_.what_survives_the_conditionality: Reason 1 is independent of any book value. The 7,769-triple shape degeneracy and the 1.695x spread in implied V/B0 are computed on cells normalised by their own grid centre and use no book value at all. NOT_IDENTIFIED therefore stands on reason 1 alone even if the adapter is wrong.

why_the_passing_candidate_is_still_not_a.what_would_have_been_prohibited: A per-asset B0 or a per-report scaler reproduces everything trivially. The evidence freeze forbids both by name, and this is precisely the case they were written to catch.
